detail.longDescription: OpenHands SDK 9.8 — sandbox control port bound to 0.0.0.0, API key hardcoded to None. Anyone who could reach the port had unauthenticated root in the container. Mounted workspace readable. Secrets store readable in plaintext. No exploit needed — the attack is an HTTP request to a service built to accept them. Fixed in 1.52.0 (Oct 5). CVE published Oct 26. Three-week lag. https:// threataft.com/articles/openhan ds-agent-sdk-cve-2026-112346-sandbox-0-0-0-0 # infosec # CVE # AI # Docker # RCE # OpenHands
